name: scaleset
description: TypeScript client for GitHub Actions Runner Scale Set APIs

scripts.check: vp check && pnpm test && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:package
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm setup:conformance && CI=false vp test run --coverage
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm setup:conformance && RUN_SCALESET_E2E=true vp test run tests/upstream-parity.test.ts tests/typescript-e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: vp test run --exclude tests/conformance.test.ts --exclude tests/upstream-parity.test.ts --exclude tests/go-subtests.test.ts --exclude tests/conformance-map.test.ts --exclude tests/typescript-e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:unit:watch: vp test --exclude tests/conformance.test.ts --exclude tests/upstream-parity.test.ts --exclude tests/go-subtests.test.ts --exclude tests/conformance-map.test.ts --exclude tests/typescript-e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:upstream: pnpm setup:conformance && vp test run tests/upstream-parity.test.ts tests/go-subtests.test.ts
scripts.test:conformance: pnpm setup:conformance && vp test run tests/conformance.test.ts
